name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages an Nginx web server hosting three sites with per-site virtual hosts, static content, self-signed HTTPS certificates, Fail2ban, UFW, SSH hardening, and sysctl security settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis password authentication, logging setup, and a post-configuration workaround for generated Redis settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub with a Python virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and credentials, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service on port 8000.
